description: This file declares the class USBDeviceImplementation which implements the IUSBDevice interface for managing USB devices, including device enumeration, information retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and event handling via hotplug callbacks. It also defines related constants, macros, and internal classes for asynchronous job dispatching.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IUSBDevice interface, manages USB device enumeration, information, driver binding, and event handling, including hotplug callbacks and asynchronous job dispatching.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation::Job
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous task for handling USB device hotplug events, dispatching notifications.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of USBDeviceImplementation, optionally creating it.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB device events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected USB devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific USB device by name.

methods.name: BindDriver
methods.description: Binds a driver to a specified USB device.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Unbinds the driver from a specified USB device.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Internal method to handle dispatching of USB device events.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a specific event for a USB device.

methods.name: libUSBInit
methods.description: Initializes the libusb context.

methods.name: libUSBClose
methods.description: Closes the libusb context.

methods.name: getUSBDevicClassFromInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves device class and subclass from interface descriptor.

methods.name: getDevicePathFromDevice
methods.description: Retrieves device path and serial number from libusb device.

methods.name: getDeviceSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves serial number from libusb device.

methods.name: getUSBDescriptorValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string descriptor value from a device handle.

methods.name: getUSBExtInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Extracts extended info from device descriptor.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Extracts device info from device descriptor.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Fills USB device structure from device descriptor.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceAttached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is attached.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceDetached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is detached.

methods.name: libUSBEventsHandlingThread
methods.description: Thread function to handle libusb events.
